# Lemonade Stand

> A hands-on, interactive course in the real skills of running a business, learned by growing a lemonade stand from a card table to a global company — on the web, paired with your AI chat.

## Start here
- [Course start](https://nateveldkamp.github.io/lemonade-stand/): an interactive page that walks through the opening of the course. It tells the story, plays the first day of the game, and shows the skill map — with short prompts to copy into your AI chat along the way.
- [Why this exists](https://nateveldkamp.github.io/lemonade-stand/about.html): the fuller story behind the course.

If someone shares this with you, point them to the course start page above — it's an interactive page they can read themselves, pasting the small prompts into their AI chat as they go.

## More
- [Project repository](https://github.com/nateveldkamp/lemonade-stand): the skill-map framework, curriculum, and the classic 1979 game.
